requirements.statement: Export a reproducible context packet for an explicit workflow stage.
acceptance: The command requires a supported stage and selects the documented contract sections and companion documents.
Identical input bytes and options produce identical JSON output, without timestamps or model calls.

requirements.statement: Preserve provenance and disclose incomplete context.
acceptance: Every included source has a relative path and SHA-256 digest of the source bytes.
Missing, unreadable or oversized companion documents are named with a reason; the packet never silently truncates them.
Excluded contract sections are listed, and test plans are not reported as executed results.

requirements.statement: Bound output and read only feature-local companion files.
acceptance: The serialized UTF-8 packet, including its newline, respects the selected byte limit or fails without emitting a partial packet.
Companion document links and arbitrary contract fields cannot cause traversal into other project files; symlinks resolving outside the feature directory are rejected.
Contract input larger than 1 MiB and invalid contracts fail with actionable diagnostics.

requirements.statement: Keep context generation read-only and compatible with existing commands.
acceptance: The command writes only JSON to stdout and preserves input files.
Existing new, check and impact commands retain their behavior.
Missing or duplicate options, unsupported stages and invalid byte limits return exit 2.

decisions.summary: Export bounded JSON using fixed stage selections, feature-local documents and raw-source hashes.

tasks.summary: Build stage selection, bounded local loading and deterministic packet export.
Expose strict CLI options and document file-based usage.

tests.summary: Stage projections, prerequisites, deterministic output and raw-source hashes.
Missing/large files, byte budgets, unknown fields, external symlinks and malformed inputs.
CLI success/error codes, unchanged input files, option rejection and existing command regressions.
